concept_gloss.text: bir söz için belirlenmiş zaman ya da yer

concept_map.definition: Verilen bir sözün ya da karşılıklı anlaşmanın gerçekleşmesi için belirlenmiş zaman veya yerdir. Aynı adın karşılıklı söz verme eylemini de gösterebildiği kullanım, zaman-yer anlamından ayrı tutulur.

facets.statement: Bir sözün veya karşılıklı anlaşmanın gerçekleşmesi için belirli bir zaman gösterilir.
Bir sözün veya karşılıklı anlaşmanın gerçekleşmesi için belirli bir yer gösterilir.
Aynı ad biçimi bazı kullanımlarda belirlenen zaman veya yer yerine karşılıklı söz verme eylemini adlandırabilir.
Belirli gün kuruluşunda önceden bildirilen ve gerçekleşmesi beklenen özel bir gün anlatılır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün veya buluşmanın ne zaman gerçekleşeceğinin belirlendiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Yer anlamı ve karşılıklı eylemi adlandıran kaynak çeşitlemesi bu karşılıkta bulunmaz.
error_profile.preserves: Önceden belirlenmiş olma ve sözle bağlantılı zaman anlamı korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün veya buluşmanın nerede gerçekleşeceğinin belirlendiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Zaman anlamı ve karşılıklı eylemi adlandıran kaynak çeşitlemesi bu karşılıkta bulunmaz.
error_profile.preserves: Önceden belirlenmiş olma ve sözle bağlantılı yer anlamı korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gerçekleşeceği önceden bildirilen belirli bir günün söz konusu olduğu özel kuruluşta kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Genel yer anlamı ve gün dışındaki zaman türleri bu karşılıkta yer almaz.
error_profile.preserves: Önceden belirlenmiş özel gün ve gelecekte gerçekleşme beklentisi korunur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği belirlenmiş zaman veya yerdir; karşılıklı söz verme eylemi yalnızca ayrı ad kullanımı olarak belirtilir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin baskın bölümü, verilen söz veya karşılıklı anlaşma için belirlenen zamanı ve yeri gösterir; bu yön geçici çerçeveyle uyumludur. Bununla birlikte aynı adın karşılıklı sözleşme eylemi için de kullanıldığı belirtilir; bu kullanım zaman-yer çekirdeğine katılmadan ayrı bir kaynak çeşitlemesi olarak korunmalıdır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: söz için kararlaştırılan zaman ya da yer

lexicalization_scope.note: Ad biçimlerinin zaman ve yer kapsamı temel alınır; belirli gün kuruluşu kendi bağlamında tutulur ve karşılıklı eylem anlamı çekirdeğe karıştırılmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; yayımlananlar söz bağı, zamanın sayılması, karşılıklı eylem ve genel konum alanı bakımından en öğretici sınırları verir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal zamanı veya yeri bir sözle ilişkilendirir; komşu dal belirlenmiş zaman yanında sözle ilgisiz genel işaret anlamlarını da taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir sözün ya da karşılıklı anlaşmanın gerçekleşeceği belirlenmiş yeri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yol işareti ve genel belirti anlamlarını da kapsayan daha geniş bir anlam alanına sahiptir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal önceden belirlenmiş zamanı gösterebilir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın kurucu bağı bir söz veya anlaşmadır; komşu dalın kurucu bağı sayma ve dönemsel yinelemedir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Zamanı veya yeri verilmiş bir söz ya da anlaşmayla ilişkilendirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Zamanın sayılması, sınırlandırılması ve bilinen aralıklarla yinelenmesi yönlerini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal belirli ve sınırlandırılmış bir zamanı anlatabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal anlaşmanın dışsal zaman-yer bağını, komşu dal ise iki taraflı söz verme eyleminin kendisini tanımlar.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Karşılıklı sözleşmenin gerçekleşeceği zaman veya yeri adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İki tarafın birbirine söz vermesi eylemini ve karşılıklı katılımcı yapısını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Karşılıklı bir anlaşma hem eylemi hem de onun zaman veya yer bağını içerebilir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal önceden kararlaştırılmış bir bağ ister; komşu dal yalnızca yakınlık veya bulunma ilişkisiyle kurulabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirlenmiş zaman veya yer, gelecekteki bir söz ya da anlaşma nedeniyle seçilmiştir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Genel yakınlık, hazır bulunma, konum ve inanıştaki yakınlık gibi çok daha geniş ilişkileri kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi zaman veya yer ilişkilerini ifade edebilir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الموعد موضع التواعد وهو الميعاد والميعاد لا يكون إلا وقتا أو موضعا (ayn)؛ الميعاد المواعدة والوقت والموضع وكذلك الموعد (sihah)؛ يكون الموعد وقتا للعدة والميعاد لا يكون إلا وقتا أو موضعا (tahdhib)؛ فاجعل بيننا وبينك موعدا وقل لكم ميعاد يوم (mufradat)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak ifadesi belirlenmiş zaman ve yer anlamlarını ortak çekirdekte toplar; ayrıca aynı adın karşılıklı söz verme eylemini gösterebildiğini ve belirli gün kullanımına girebildiğini bildirir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الموعد والميعاد وقتا أو موضعا للعدة أو التواعد، وما يسمى موعدا محددا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس نفس مضمون الوعد خيرا أو شرا، ولا التهديد.

concept_gloss.applicability: İki tarafın da birbirine söz verdiği karşılıklı eylemin tam çekirdeğini doğal ve kısa biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: İki taraflı katılımcı yapısı, her iki tarafın söz vermesi ve gelecek yönelimi korunur.

concept_map.definition: İki tarafın geleceğe yönelik olarak birbirine söz vermesi ve böylece her tarafın ötekinin hem söz vereni hem de söz alanı olmasıdır. Karşılıklı sözleşmenin yeriyle ilişkili ad kullanımı bu eylemin kendisinden ayrı tutulur.

facets.statement: İki tarafın her biri ötekine söz verir; söz verme ilişkisi tek yönlü değil karşılıklıdır.
Aynı anlam alanındaki bir ad, karşılıklı sözleşmeyle bağlantılı yeri gösterebilir; yer eylemin kurucu parçası değildir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir topluluğun veya iki kişinin karşılıklı olarak söz verdiği bağlamlarda kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Tarafların birbirlerine yönelmesi ve her iki tarafın da söz vermesi açıkça korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Karşılıklı söz verme eyleminin bağlamdan açıkça anlaşıldığı kısa anlatımlarda kullanılabilir.

error_profile.adds: Güncel kullanımda resmî anlaşma veya yazılı belge anlamını da çağrıştırabilir.
error_profile.collision: Hukuki belge anlamıyla bağlama bağlı olarak karışabilir.
error_profile.preserves: İki tarafın karşılıklı bir yüklenime girmesi yönü korunur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Karşılıklılık kurucu koşuldur; tek taraflı söz verme ve yalnızca zaman ya da yer bildirme bu dala girmez.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin ortak çekirdeği, iki tarafın birbirine söz vermesi ve her birinin hem söz veren hem söz alan olmasıdır. Tek bir kaynak parçasındaki yer bildirimi karşılıklı eylemle ilişkili olsa da eylemin kendisini tanımlamaz; bu nedenle dal karşılıklılık çekirdeğiyle korunup yer ilişkisi ikincil tutulmalıdır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: karşılıklı söz verme; buluşmak üzere anlaşma

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım karşılıklılık bildiren türemiş ad ve eylem biçimleriyle sınırlıdır; bunlardan tek taraflı yalın anlam çıkarılmaz ve ilişkili yer kullanımı çekirdeğe katılmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; yayımlananlar tek taraflılık, belirli işte bağlanma, pekiştirilmiş bağ ve zaman-yer ilişkisi üzerinden karşılıklılık sınırını açıklar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda iki katılımcı da söz veren konumundadır; komşu dalda yalnızca bir tarafın bildirimi anlamı kurmaya yeter.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Her iki tarafın da birbirine söz vermesini zorunlu kılar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Tek bir tarafın iyi ya da kötü bir şey yapacağını bildirmesiyle kurulabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal geleceğe yönelik söz verme ilişkisini anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın çekirdeği karşılıklı söz vermedir; komşu dal yüklenimin belirli bir iş üzerinde bağlayıcı ilişki kurmasını öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tarafların birbirlerine geleceğe yönelik söz vermesini özellikle belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Belirli bir iş konusunda karşılıklı yüklenim ve bağ kurma yönünü daha güçlü taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda iki taraf karşılıklı olarak bir yüklenime girer.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal karşılıklılıkla yetinir; komşu dal daha güçlü, sağlamlaştırılmış ve kimi zaman yeminle desteklenen bir bağdır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sıradan karşılıklı söz verme yeterlidir; ayrıca güçlendirme koşulu aranmaz.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bağın sağlamlaştırılması, pekiştirilmesi veya yeminle güçlendirilmesi kurucu özelliktir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal iki taraf arasında geleceğe yönelik bir bağ kurar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal katılımcıların karşılıklı eylemidir; komşu dal eylemin gerçekleşeceği dışsal zaman veya yer çerçevesidir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İki tarafın birbirine söz verme eylemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bu eylem için belirlenen zamanı veya yeri anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Aynı karşılıklı anlaşma olayında eylem ile onun zaman-yer bağı birlikte bulunabilir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: والمواعدة من الميعاد (maqayis)؛ موضع التواعد (ayn)؛ تواعد القوم أي وعد بعضهم بعضا (sihah)؛ واعدت فلانا إذا وعدته ووعدني (tahdhib)؛ واعدته وتواعدنا (mufradat)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak ifadesi karşılıklı söz verme eylemini ortaklaştırır: taraflar birbirlerine söz verir. İlişkili yer bildirimi bu çekirdeğin yanında yer alan, fakat onu zaman-yer dalıyla birleştirmeyen bir kullanımdır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه واعد وتواعد إذا وعد كل طرف صاحبه أو وقع الوعد من الجانبين.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الوعد من طرف واحد، ولا الموعد بمعنى الزمان أو المكان وحده.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hayvan, ses ve yaklaşan saldırı koşullarını birlikte taşıyan kuruluşa özgü tam karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Erkek hayvan, kükreme, saldırı niyeti ve saldırıdan önceki aşama birlikte korunur.

concept_map.definition: Erkek hayvanın saldırmaya yöneldiği sırada, saldırıdan hemen önce çıkardığı kükremedir. Anlam hayvan, ses ve yaklaşan saldırı koşullarının birlikte bulunduğu özel kuruluşa bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Erkek hayvan güçlü ve belirgin bir kükreme çıkarır.
Kükreme, hayvanın saldırmaya yöneldiği anda ve yaklaşan saldırının işareti olarak ortaya çıkar.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hayvanın cinsiyetinin bağlamdan belli olduğu ve saldırı hazırlığının açıklanması gereken yerde kullanılır.

error_profile.adds: Erkek hayvanla sınırlı olmayan daha geniş bir hayvan kümesini çağrıştırır.
error_profile.preserves: Kükreme, saldırı hazırlığı ve saldırı öncesi aşama korunur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca erkek hayvanın saldırı öncesi kükremesini adlandıran kuruluşta geçerlidir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli kuruluşu, erkek hayvanın saldırmaya yönelirken çıkardığı kükreme olarak tutarlı biçimde tanımlar. Bu, insanın sözlü korkutması veya genel hayvan sesi değil, saldırı niyetine bağlı özel bir davranıştır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca verilen hayvan ve saldırı koşullu kuruluşa bağlıdır; buradan yalın bir korkutma, kükreme veya söz verme anlamı çıkarılmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; yayımlananlar saldırı süreci, öfke niteliği, genel yüksek ses ve sürüyü çağırma işlevi bakımından özel kuruluşu sınırlar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal saldırı öncesindeki belirli sese bağlı dar bir kuruluştur; komşu dal sesi, coşmayı ve saldırıyı daha geniş bir süreçte toplar.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Erkek hayvanın saldırıdan hemen önce çıkardığı sesi özellikle adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Hayvanın genel coşması, saldırması ve kükremesinin yanında insan öfkesi ile dalga hareketine de uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal erkek hayvanın coşup kükreyerek saldırmaya yönelmesini kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli saldırı öncesi sese, komşu dal ise daha genel öfke durumuna ve bu durumdaki ses niteliğine odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Saldırıya yönelen erkek hayvanın çıkardığı belirli kükremeyi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: şiddetli öfke ve içten gelen ses
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Şiddetli öfke durumunu ve hayvanın içinden gelen sesi bir nitelik olarak da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal öfkelenip saldırmaya yönelen erkek hayvanın sesini kapsayabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda saldırı niyeti ve belirli hayvan koşulu kurucudur; komşu dalda yüksek ses çıkarmak tek başına yeterlidir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sesin erkek hayvanın yaklaşan saldırısıyla bağlantılı olması zorunludur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İnsan veya çeşitli hayvanların genel bağırmasını ve yüksek ses çıkarmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal sığır türü bir hayvanın yüksek sesini anlatabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal saldırı hazırlığına, komşu dal ise dişi sürünün sese yönelip durulmasına bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kükreme yaklaşan saldırının göstergesidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Erkek hayvanın sesi dişi sürüyü kendine çekip durultur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki durumda erkek hayvanın sesi belirli bir davranışsal olayda rol oynar.

branches.source_phrase_ar: وعيد الفحل هديره إذا هم أن يصول (maqayis)؛ وعيد الفحل إذا هم أن يصول (ayn)؛ وعيد الفحل هديره إذا هم أن يصول (sihah)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, erkek hayvanın saldırmaya hazırlanırken çıkardığı kükremeyi aynı özel kuruluş altında birleştirir; saldırı niyeti sesin ayırt edici koşuludur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه وعيد الفحل وهديره إذا هم أن يصول.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس تهديد الإنسان بالقول، ولا الوعد بالخير أو الشر.

branches.branch_image_ar: أمارة واعدة يرجى منها حال آت

concept_gloss.applicability: Yarar, hava durumu, gelişme veya huy gibi farklı sonuçları tek bir belirtiye dayalı beklenti çekirdeğinde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Mevcut belirti, gelecek yönelimi ve henüz gerçekleşmemiş durum hakkında beklenti oluşması korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlıkta veya durumun başlangıcında görülen belirtilerin, gelecekte ortaya çıkacak bir özellik ya da sonuç için beklenti doğurmasıdır. Toprağın yağmur ve bitki, günün sıcaklık veya soğukluk, hayvanın gelişme, insanın da huy bakımından değerlendirilmesi bu çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Şimdiki belirtiler, gelecekte ortaya çıkacak bir durum, özellik veya sonuç için beklenti doğurur.
Topraktaki belirtiler, ileride yağmur alınacağı ve bitki yetişeceği umudunu doğurabilir.
Günün başlangıcı, ilerleyen saatlerde sıcaklık veya soğukluk görüleceğini gösterebilir.
Bir hayvanın belirtileri, ondan iyilik veya olumlu gelişme bekleneceğini gösterebilir.
Bir insanın görünür belirtileri, cömertlik, dayanıklılık veya kararlılık gibi huyların beklendiğini gösterebilir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Toprak, hayvan veya insan belirtilerinden olumlu bir sonuç beklendiği bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.loses: Sıcak veya soğuk gibi olumlu olmak zorunda olmayan gelecek durumları bu karşılık kapsamaz.
error_profile.preserves: Mevcut belirtilerden gelecekte olumlu bir sonuç beklenmesi yönü korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Olumlu ve yansız sonuçları birlikte kapsamak gereken açıklayıcı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirtiye dayanma, gelecekteki durum ve bunun hakkında beklenti oluşturma yönleri korunur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal sözlü bir yüklenimi değil, mevcut belirtilerin gelecekteki durum hakkında beklenti doğurmasını anlatır.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, gözle görülür belirtilerden toprak, gün, hayvan veya insan hakkında gelecek bir durumun beklenmesini ortaklaştırır. Beklenen şey her zaman iyilik değildir; günün başlangıcı sıcaklık ya da soğukluk gösterebildiği için çekirdek, olumlu umut yerine belirtiye dayalı gelecek beklentisi olarak kurulmalıdır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yağmur ve bitki bakımından umut veren toprak
başlangıcı sıcak ya da soğuk olacağını gösteren gün
iyiliği ve gelişmesi umulan hayvan ya da sürü
belirtileri cömertlik ve sağlam huy bekleten

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel niteleme ile toprak, gün, hayvan ve insan belirtilerine bağlı kuruluşlar ayrı örnekler olarak korunur; bunlardan sözlü söz verme anlamı çıkarılmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; yayımlananlar yağmur göstergesi, insanda iyilik sezme, yalancı belirti, içsel umut ve sözlü bildirim üzerinden dalın sınırını keskinleştirir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel belirtiye dayalı gelecek beklentisidir; komşu dal yalnızca gökyüzü veya bulutun yağmur göstergesi olmasına bağlanır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Toprak, gün, hayvan ve insan dahil farklı taşıyıcılardaki belirtileri ve farklı gelecek durumlarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Gökyüzü ve bulut belirtilerinden özellikle yağmur beklenmesiyle sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal mevcut bir hava veya çevre belirtisinden gelecekte yağmur beklenmesini kapsayabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal geniş bir belirti ve taşıyıcı alanına sahiptir; komşu dal insan üzerinde iyilik sezmekle sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İnsan dışındaki toprak, gün ve hayvan belirtilerini de kapsar; beklenen sonuç yalnızca iyilik değildir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir insanda özellikle iyilik sezme ve onu iyiye yorma eylemine odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi bir insanın görünür belirtilerinden olumlu bir huy veya sonuç beklemeyi kapsayabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal beklenti doğuran göstergeyi sonucundan bağımsız tanımlar; komşu dal göstergenin özellikle yalancı ve karşılıksız olduğunu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirtinin gelecekteki durum için gerçek bir beklenti dayanağı olması yeterlidir; sonucun gerçekleşmesi zorunlu değildir.

text.arabic_uthmani: وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ذُو ٱلرَّحْمَةِ ۖ لَوْ يُؤَاخِذُهُم بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ لَعَجَّلَ لَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ۚ بَل لَّهُم مَّوْعِدٌۭ لَّن يَجِدُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦ مَوْئِلًۭا

baseline.text: Rabbin çok bağışlayandır, rahmet sahibidir. Kazandıkları yüzünden onları hemen sorumlu tutsaydı azabı çabucak getirirdi. Fakat onlar için belirlenmiş bir zaman vardır; Ondan başka sığınacak yer bulamazlar.

findings.text: Merhamet ve bağışlama, kazanılan sonuçla yakalanma arasına yönetilmiş zaman koyan bir kalkan gibi işler; hesabı silmeden kapanışı geciktirir.

activation_trace.role: Repair and staged nurture make Lordship the governing frame for delay.
Covering sin and shielding its bearer from its effect supplies the protective operation of non-immediate punishment.
Tenderness and beneficence supply the merciful motive of that restraint.
Speeding and advancing before due time names the counterfactual action explicitly withheld.
A promise bounded by a time or place gives mercy a fixed horizon rather than an indefinite suspension.

changed_reading.after: Forgiveness is a governed reprieve: immediate seizure is withheld by merciful care while a bounded appointment remains.
changed_reading.before: Forgiveness simply cancels or overlooks punishment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ربك الغفور ذو الرحمة and the counterfactual لو ... لعجل
baseline_models.mechanism: Lordship as staged cultivation, forgiveness as protection from an earned effect, and mercy as beneficence jointly restrain acceleration; the fixed appointment preserves governance without making non-immediacy into cancellation.

activation_trace.role: Being taken to task for an issued deed supplies the judicial conversion from act to liability.
Seeking and acquiring benefit for oneself makes the liability self-acquired rather than externally arbitrary.
Painful punishment supplies the consequence attached to the acquired account.
The bounded appointment schedules rather than dissolves that consequence.

changed_reading.after: The ayah describes a self-acquired account whose conversion into punishment is real but deliberately scheduled.
changed_reading.before: Punishment is an externally imposed threat that has merely not happened yet.

baseline_models.mechanism: The objects of account are what the subjects acquired for themselves; taking-to-account converts acquisition into consequence, but acceleration is denied and the consequence is assigned to an appointment.

activation_trace.role: Locating or attaining a sought object makes the negation an unsuccessful search, not merely nonexistence.
Otherness and substitution define the searched-for refuge as an alternative to the governing referent.
Flight to safety supplies the unavailable protective destination.

changed_reading.after: They will search unsuccessfully for any alternative source, route, or destination of protection; whether دونه points to the Lord or the appointment remains open.
changed_reading.before: They will have no physical hiding place.

baseline_models.mechanism: Finding is blocked, duna marks an alternative or lesser substitute, and maw'il is a refuge or means of escape; together they deny access to any protective alternative outside the pronoun's referent.

activation_trace.role: Self-acquisition anchors the context's contrast as a sorting of what people accumulate.
Dry broken vegetation supplies the terminal state of apparently flourishing acquisition.
Wind-winnowing and dispersal turn that terminal state into loss of cohesion and possession.
Effective capacity removes inability as the explanation for delayed consequence.
Endurance supplies the contrasting criterion by which some acquisitions survive the interval.
Recompense returning to its doer makes endurance consequential rather than merely temporal.

changed_reading.after: Merciful delay is an active sorting interval in which acquisitions reveal whether they disperse or return to their doer.
changed_reading.before: Merciful delay is an inactive pause before accounting.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reprieve becomes an evaluative interval: worldly growth can dry, break, and disperse under undiminished power, while lasting deeds remain and return as recompense. What is earned is therefore disclosed by durability before the appointment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies transience, divine capacity, endurance, and returning recompense; I infer that these describe what the focus reprieve does by sorting acquisitions over time. Alternatively, they may contrast worldly and lasting value without defining the delay itself.
structural_cues: 18:45 rapidly sequences water, mixed growth, morning debris, and wind dispersal; 18:46 then contrasts adornment with remaining deeds.

activation_trace.role: The focus appointment anchors the context sequence as specification of its bounded horizon.
Exposure and disclosure remove concealment from the appointment's spatial setting.
Driving and gathering a group toward one destination supplies the assembly mechanism.
The same bounded appointment is explicitly the object whose existence had been denied.
A writing that fixes an obligating judgment supplies the appointment's record.
Exhaustive counting makes the record comprehensive rather than selective.
Finding the deeds resolves the focus search verb toward attained evidence before its later negated search for refuge.
Presence and nearness make past action evidentially current at the forum.

changed_reading.after: The موعد is an exhaustive forum where subjects and their self-acquired acts are exposed, assembled, and made present for account.
changed_reading.before: The موعد is only a future date at which punishment begins.

context_deltas.mechanism: The appointment acquires institutional shape: all are driven into an exposed assembly, the denied موعد is affirmed, a binding record exhaustively counts, and earned acts are found present. The date is thus a forum of manifestation and account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, exposure, the repeated موعد, and present recorded deeds; I infer that this sequence gives the focus appointment its forum-like function. Alternatively, the scenes may describe final accounting broadly without specifying every use of موعد.
structural_cues: 18:47-49 moves from universal gathering, through denial of an appointment, to a record in which deeds are found present.

activation_trace.role: Otherness and substitution anchor the model in the focus phrase من دونه.
Seeking a safe refuge names the protective function whose substitutes are tested.
The parallel من دوني explicitly places a chosen substitute in the position of other-than-God.
Loyalty, aid, and patronage supply the first attempted social technology of refuge.
One thing standing in another's place marks that patronage as an exchange of protectors.
A strengthening helper supplies the support function explicitly refused to misleaders.
Answering speech supplies the expected rescue response that the invoked partners fail to give.
Entrapment from which one cannot disengage converts failed response into failed release.
Turning something away supplies the final unavailable escape function: diversion from the encountered fire.

changed_reading.after: No refuge means no alternative patron, support, respondent, release mechanism, or diversion can perform protection.
changed_reading.before: No refuge means there is nowhere else to hide.

context_deltas.mechanism: The unavailable maw'il is tested through successive substitute functions: an adopted patron, an exchanged authority, a strengthening arm, a responsive partner, release from entrapment, and a diversion from encounter. Every relational form of refuge fails.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a chain of failed patronage, support, response, release, and diversion; I infer that these are functional expansions of the focus موئلا. Alternatively, موئلا may retain the narrower sense of a destination while these failures remain adjacent examples.
structural_cues: 18:50-53 repeats substitute relations and then stages their failure as denied support, unanswered invocation, entrapment, and no diversion.

activation_trace.role: Protective forgiveness anchors the interval as potentially reparative.
Twisted disputation supplies a way repeated examples are deflected rather than received.
Seeking the same protective forgiveness makes repair an explicit live possibility before punishment arrives.
Warning that awakens caution fills the reprieve with advance notice.
A reminder supplies a renewed retrieval point after prior notice.
Sending deeds ahead connects the focus's acquired account to what accumulates during the interval.
A preserving cover becomes, in this construction, an obstruction that prevents the warning from being understood.

changed_reading.after: The postponement is a warned opportunity for repair during which the account can still grow and receptivity can still close.
changed_reading.before: The postponement is silent waiting that leaves the account unchanged.

context_deltas.mechanism: The delay before account is populated by varied examples, the still-open possibility of seeking forgiveness, warnings, and reminder. Yet argument, forgetting what hands sent ahead, and a covering over comprehension can consume that interval without repair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies communicative opportunities and their obstruction; I infer that this sequence is the content of merciful non-hastening and that deeds continue to be sent ahead within it. Alternatively, the sequence may diagnose refusal without defining the theological purpose of delay.
structural_cues: 18:54-57 fills the interval before 18:58 with examples, guidance, messengers, warning, reminder, and repeated refusal.

activation_trace.role: The bounded focus appointment anchors postponement in a definite horizon.
Falling into destruction supplies the realized endpoint of the surrounding reprieve.
The repeated bounded appointment assigns even communal destruction its time rather than making it immediate.

changed_reading.after: Mercy governs the timing of consequence: it blocks premature seizure but does not remove a fixed individual or communal horizon.
changed_reading.before: Mercy and punishment pull in opposite directions, with mercy perhaps displacing punishment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel repeats موعد for destroyed settlements, binding merciful non-hastening to a fixed communal horizon: reprieve is real, but accumulated wrongdoing can reach an appointed collapse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated appointment and a realized communal destruction; I infer that the sequel demonstrates the focus principle at collective scale. Alternatively, 18:59 may offer a separate historical analogy rather than define the focus subjects' own موعد.
structural_cues: 18:59 immediately restates موعد after 18:58 and binds it to settlements destroyed when they wronged.

remaining_uncertainties: The referent of دونه can remain the Lord, the appointment, or the impending consequence; the no-substitute mechanism survives, but its center shifts.
The context sequence may functionally define the reprieve, or it may only surround it with analogies of transience, warning, and account.
The counted-gestation reading depends on deliberately exploratory branch transfer and should not control a conservative synthesis.
strongest_changes: The موعد becomes an exhaustive forum where acquired deeds are made present, not merely a delayed date.
No موئل expands from no hiding place to failure of every substitute patron, support, respondent, release, and diversion.
Merciful delay becomes a warned and evaluative interval while 18:59 preserves its fixed communal horizon.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly converted spatial refuge into relational dependence and temporal deferment into an active process; the split وعد-to-عدد inventory also preserved a contained counted-wait outlier.

activation_trace.role: The womb as a containing place of growth supplies an exploratory spatial image for mercy.
Staged nurture supplies the process occurring within that containing interval.
A counted waiting period supplies the interval's measured duration through the packet's non-dominant mapped root.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, mercy is a containing, nurturing, counted interval in which the account is carried toward a due emergence.
changed_reading.before: Mercy is only an attitude that postpones an otherwise unchanged event.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines the anatomical رحم branch with the form-distant وعد-to-عدد split mapping. It remains anchored in ذو الرحمة, nurturing Lordship, non-hastening, and موعد; downstream prose should present it only as a material-temporal analogy, not as a lexical equation or a claim that punishment is literally gestated.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ذو الرحمة ... لو يؤاخذهم ... لعجل ... بل لهم موعد

activation_trace.role: A covering that protects supplies the focus side of the contrast.
A preserving cover placed over hearts supplies the obstructive side when coupled to inability to understand.

changed_reading.after: Covering bifurcates: forgiveness can shield a person from immediate effect, while a heart-cover can shield the settled disposition from corrective understanding.
changed_reading.before: All covering in the sequence amounts to erasure or concealment of guilt.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links two different roots through a shared covering topology. It remains anchored in الغفور and is directly activated by the heart coverings in 18:57; downstream prose should qualify it as a contrastive mechanism, not claim that غفر and كنن are synonyms or that forgiveness causes incomprehension.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: الغفور in 18:58 against أكنة أن يفقهوه in 18:57

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Mercy inserts time between earning and seizure.** `ر ح م` B001 (“mercy and tenderness”) structurally blocks the counterfactual immediate punishment and replaces it with an appointment. The hidden interventions of 18:79–82 likewise protect futures invisible in present surfaces. I infer that mercy operates temporally by delaying closure, without canceling accountability or creating escape. The ayah reads delay as active governance rather than inattention.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:82 and 18:98 made merciful delay concrete as preservation until maturity and protection until an appointment.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Forgiveness as a temporal shield rather than erased consequence.** `غ ف ر/B002` is forgiving and shielding from consequence; `غ ف ر/B001` is literal protective covering. The fixed counterfactual says immediate seizure is withheld but an appointment remains; 18:59 gives ruined towns their own appointment, while 18:60–63 opens a journey whose missed marker can still be recovered by return. I infer that mercy creates protected response-time without abolishing direction or limit. `ٱلْغَفُور` reads as active postponing cover, sharply distinct from the blocking covers of 18:57.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:59 confirmed timed consequence, while 18:63 showed a missed marker recoverable within delayed travel, sharpening mercy as usable interval.

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction launching a new divine-attribute declaration while carrying forward the prior warning
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resumes after 18:57 and launches the attribute sentence as its own declaration. The opening therefore carries the warning forward, but it makes divine character, not the conditional punishment, the first frame the reader must process.

topics.headline: resumptive attribute opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah answers the sealed warning of 18:57 by reopening discourse through divine character before any punishment scenario appears.
topics.reason: The conjunction is constrained by QAC as a conjunction and by the opening nominal clause; the CRITICAL rows coherently read it as both continuation and fresh resumption.

words.gloss_range: directly addressed Lord-title serving as the subject of a double-predicate nominal clause
words.prose: {{ar:رَبُّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbuka}}) is the addressed subject of the opening nominal clause, and both forgiveness and mercy-possession predicate from it. The title also keeps delay under lordly management: the one who could hold them to account is presented first as the sustaining Lord whose governance has a scheduled endpoint.
words.root_gloss_range: lordship range of possession, sustaining governance, nurture, and completion; local use selects directly addressed governing care before accountability

topics.headline: addressed lordship anchors two predicates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that forgiveness and mercy are stable predicates of the addressed Lord before the ayah imagines any taking-to-account.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the word the nominative subject of the nominal opening, with the second-person suffix fixing the address relation.

topics.headline: lordship as managed delay
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the delay of punishment belongs to governing lordship, not to weakness or neglect.
topics.reason: The root-family rows align with the local movement from addressed Lord to mercy, hypothetical seizure, and appointed time; no guardrail contradicts the developmental/governance pressure.

words.gloss_range: definite intensive forgiveness predicate explaining withheld immediate exposure and punishment
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْغَفُورُ}} ({{tr:al-ghafuru}}) stands as the first definite predicate of {{ar:رَبُّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbuka}}), with an intensive form that makes covering-forgiveness durable. Its root image lets deferral feel like covered exposure rather than erased accountability; punishment remains possible, but it is not accelerated before mercy and appointment have defined the frame.
words.root_gloss_range: covering, shielding, and forgiving; local form selects an enduring divine attribute, with covering imagery supporting deferral rather than erasure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: addressed Lord-title anchoring the opening predicates

topics.headline: intensive covering-forgiveness predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first predicate is a durable title-like capacity for covering, not a single act of pardon.
topics.reason: QAC marks a definite nominative intensive predicate, and the rows coherently connect that form to the restraint that follows.

topics.headline: covering before mercy and punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that covering-forgiveness delays exposure while leaving the earned accountability and appointment intact.
topics.reason: The cover-root rows, attribute-pair rows, and punishment-context rows fit the clause order: forgiveness precedes mercy-possession and the unreal acceleration of punishment.

words.gloss_range: nominative five-noun construct head making mercy-possession a second predicate
words.prose: {{ar:ذُو}} ({{tr:dhu}}) makes the mercy phrase a second predicate, not an afterthought to forgiveness. As a nominative five-noun construct, it presents mercy as something possessed and administered by the Lord, so the later refusal to hasten punishment is grounded in owned mercy rather than mere postponement.
words.root_gloss_range: possession/endowment relation; local five-noun construct selects possessed mercy as an administered domain

topics.headline: mercy-possession as second predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that mercy is not merely adjectival; it is grammatically held as a possessed domain of the Lord.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces the predicate and construct relations, and the five-noun nominative form confirms the phrase as a second assertion about the subject.

words.gloss_range: definite mercy maṣdar governed by the construct, closing the opening attribute beat
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلرَّحْمَةِ}} ({{tr:ar-rahmati}}) is the definite genitive content possessed by {{ar:ذُو}} ({{tr:dhu}}). Because it is a maṣdar rather than a simple adjective, mercy reads as a domain or resource; because it closes the opening beat, the following {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}) condition is heard through protective restraint before punishment is imagined.
words.root_gloss_range: compassion, womb-like enclosure, protective care; local maṣdar names mercy as a definite possessed domain restraining acceleration

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: construct head that governs the mercy noun
unreal conditional particle following the mercy threshold

topics.headline: definite possessed mercy as threshold
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that mercy forms the last word before the unreal condition, so the punishment scenario is entered through protective mercy.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the noun genitive under the construct, while the CRITICAL rows validly preserve the definite maṣdar and womb/protective-domain pressure.

words.gloss_range: unreal conditional particle governing the immediate-accountability scenario
words.prose: {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}) opens the middle scene as an unreal condition. It makes the taking-to-account and the hastened punishment a counterfactual package, so what does not happen becomes evidence for the opening attributes.

topics.headline: unreal condition frames non-hastening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that immediate accountability and hastened punishment are presented as the unreal alternative that proves restraint.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment constraints identify the protasis-apodosis construction, and the response-lam rows confirm the two-part hinge.

words.gloss_range: Form III taking-to-account with divine pro-drop subject, plural object, and causal earnings phrase
words.prose: {{ar:يُؤَاخِذُهُمْ}} ({{tr:yuakhidhuhum}}) makes the Lord the recoverable subject and the carried-over group the direct object. The Form III shape gives the verb the force of taking to account rather than bare capture, while the following causal phrase keeps what they earned as the basis of that accountability. The phrase also resonates with 2:225 and 35:45, but here the consequence is framed as unreal acceleration rather than the local final reality.
words.root_gloss_range: taking, seizing, taking to task, and holding accountable; local Form III selects juridical accountability rather than simple capture

topics.headline: people seized to account, earnings as cause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people are the direct object of accountability while their earnings are the causal basis, so persons and deeds are kept distinct.
topics.reason: Verb-instance evidence confirms a clitic object plus bi-prepositional cause, matching the CRITICAL valency rows.

topics.headline: Form III juridical seizure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb is not bare seizing; it is taking-to-task under an unreal condition.
topics.reason: The Form III tag and lexical rows support accountability as juridical seizure, with imperfect-under-law giving it an ongoing hypothetical force.

topics.headline: earnings-accountability formula echoes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 18:58 uses a known earnings-accountability formula but widens it beyond the explicit heart wording of 2:225 and redirects the result toward appointment rather than immediate annihilation.
topics.reason: The intertext rows give concrete anchors including 2:225 and 35:45; they illuminate formulaic pressure without overriding local syntax.

words.gloss_range: causal preposition binding earned content to the accountability verb
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) turns the following open relative phrase into the cause or basis of accountability. Its small prepositional link prevents a flat verb-object reading: the Lord would hold them, as persons, because of what they earned.

topics.headline: causal basis of accountability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the earned content is the legal-moral basis of seizure, not a second object or loose circumstance.
topics.reason: QAC labels the particle as instrument/cause, and attachment evidence governs the relative phrase through the preposition.

words.gloss_range: open relative pronoun covering the content or process of earning
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}) leaves the accountable content open. It can point to what they earned and, by the CRITICAL ambiguity, to the earning process itself; either way the causal phrase remains broad rather than inventorying one named sin.

topics.headline: open scope of what was earned
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accountable basis stays open enough to include both earned things and the earning process itself.
topics.reason: QAC marks a relative pronoun, while the CRITICAL rows validly preserve the relative-versus-maṣdariyya ambiguity as a scope pressure.

words.gloss_range: perfect plural earning verb with elided object, presenting completed accrued responsibility
words.prose: {{ar:كَسَبُوا۟}} ({{tr:kasabu}}) is perfect and plural, so the accountable material is already accrued by the same group. Its Form I breadth and objectless surface keep ordinary accrual, moral acquisition, and gathered deeds within scope; against 18:57, what they forgot remains available as the cause of divine accountability.
words.root_gloss_range: earning, gaining, acquiring, seeking, and gathering; local Form I keeps broad accrual rather than a narrower deliberate Form VIII sense

topics.headline: completed but open-ended accrual
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that their deeds have already accrued before accountability is imagined, but the object remains broad.
topics.reason: QAC marks perfect Form I plural, and attachment evidence makes the relative pronoun its object; the object omission rows are locally coherent.

topics.headline: Form I and boundary accountability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 18:58 recasts the forgotten hand-output of 18:57 as earned cause for possible accountability, using broad Form I accrual rather than narrowing to deliberate acquisition.
topics.reason: The Form I rows and boundary/intertext rows are compatible with the local perfect plural verb and do not require a narrower object.

words.gloss_range: response-lām marking the apodosis of the unreal condition
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) marks the answer to {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}). It lets the reader parse the next verb as the would-have result inside the counterfactual, not as a factual action.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: unreal conditional particle answered by this response-lam

topics.headline: answer-particle for unreal result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices exactly where the unreal condition turns into its would-have result.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle as lām al-jawāb, and the rows coherently pair it with the earlier conditional particle.

words.gloss_range: Form II causative acceleration of punishment within the unreal apodosis
words.prose: {{ar:عَجَّلَ}} ({{tr:ajjala}}) is a causative timing verb in the counterfactual apodosis. It imagines punishment being pushed forward for them, which makes the later appointment decisive: mercy does not deny consequence, but refuses to advance it before its scheduled point.
words.root_gloss_range: haste, immediacy, and causing something to be advanced; local Form II selects moving punishment forward from its appointed timing

topics.headline: causative acceleration of punishment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the unreal action is not creating punishment but dragging its arrival earlier than the appointed schedule.
topics.reason: QAC marks Form II perfect, attachment evidence gives object plus recipient, and the later appointment noun confirms the schedule contrast.

topics.headline: hastening formula under restraint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that familiar hastened-punishment pressure is present only as a denied alternative to the actual appointment.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence and boundary rows support the formulaic timing pressure while law keeps it counterfactual.

words.gloss_range: dative lām marking the harmed endpoint of the hastened-punishment clause
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) begins the dative phrase inside the unreal punishment clause. Because the object is punishment, the direction is detrimental: the consequence would be moved toward them, and the phrase foregrounds them before the object is named.

topics.headline: punishment directed against them
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the group is foregrounded as the affected endpoint before the punishment object lands.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence governs the pronoun through the preposition under the hastening verb, and the punishment context narrows the dative to detriment.

words.gloss_range: plural pronoun object of the dative phrase, keeping the 18:57 group in view
words.prose: {{ar:هُمُ}} ({{tr:humu}}) keeps the prior group from 18:57 inside the apodosis. They are not agents here but the people toward whom the unreal punishment would move, and this first for-them phrase prepares the later for-them appointment phrase.

topics.headline: same group as unreal recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same carried-over group remains in focus through the shift from accountability basis to punishment recipient.
topics.reason: QAC and translation-support evidence keep the plural pronouns tied to the prior group; the later reprise validates the local pronoun echo.

words.gloss_range: definite punishment maṣdar as the object that would be accelerated
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَذَابَ}} ({{tr:al-adhaba}}) is the definite object of the acceleration verb. The ayah names a recognizable punishment, but it names it at the end of the counterfactual half; immediately afterward, the structure turns from unreal hastening to actual appointment.
words.root_gloss_range: punishment, suffering, torment, with a noted sweet-water polarity; local use selects the definite punitive consequence under timing control

topics.headline: punishment as moved object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that punishment is the object whose timing would be advanced, not the final factual verdict of the ayah.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment mark the noun as definite accusative direct object of the hastening verb; bal immediately redirects from this counterfactual close.

topics.headline: punishment held under mercy and timing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the familiar punishment term is real in the warning field, but in this ayah it is held beneath mercy and appointment rather than hastened.
topics.reason: The mercy-punishment and 18:55 echo rows support tension and continuity; local law and bal prevent treating the punishment as the actual immediate outcome.

words.gloss_range: corrective pivot from unreal accelerated punishment to actual appointment
words.prose: {{ar:بَلْ}} ({{tr:bal}}) is the central corrective turn. It moves the reader out of the unreal punishment apodosis and into what actually stands for the group: an assigned appointment.

topics.headline: corrective pivot to actual appointment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not stop at punishment; it corrects the imagined immediate result into the factual appointment.
topics.reason: QAC marks an adversative/corrective conjunction, and attachment clauses identify the post-bal nominal clause as the actual appointment statement.

words.gloss_range: fronted possessive/dative lām assigning the appointment to the group
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) opens the fronted for-them predicate after the pivot. Unlike the earlier detrimental dative before punishment, this lām assigns an appointment to the same group as their actual future status.

topics.headline: appointment assigned for them
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the appointment is assigned to them before its noun is named.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the fronted prepositional phrase as predicate of the delayed appointment subject, supporting assignment rather than optional possession.

words.gloss_range: plural pronoun anchoring the same group in the actual appointment clause
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) holds the same plural referent after {{ar:بَلْ}} ({{tr:bal}}). The pronoun reprise creates a local contrast: punishment would have been for them, but what actually exists for them is an appointment.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: corrective pivot from unreal punishment to actual appointment

topics.headline: same group reassigned after pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that bal changes the predicate about the group, not the group itself: unreal punishment for them becomes actual appointment for them.
topics.reason: Referent evidence and the repeated lām-pronoun construction keep the prior group constant across the pivot.

words.gloss_range: indefinite time-place appointment noun asserted as the factual replacement for hastened punishment
words.prose: {{ar:مَوْعِدٌ}} ({{tr:mawidun}}) is the factual replacement after {{ar:بَلْ}} ({{tr:bal}}): an appointment exists for them. The bundle’s assigned root is narrowed toward the standard promise/threat appointment field, so the word carries a time-place rendezvous force rather than a generic delay. Its indefiniteness leaves the details unnamed but certain, and 18:59 immediately makes this appointment language concrete in the destruction of towns. It also sounds ahead to the final refuge noun, so the affirmed appointment and the denied refuge become near counterparts.
words.root_gloss_range: assigned data gives {{ar:ع و م}} ({{tr:ʿ-w-m}}), but local lexical evidence narrows/corrects the word toward {{ar:و ع د}} ({{tr:w-ʿ-d}}): promise, threat, appointed time/place, and fulfillment point

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: corrective pivot that introduces the actual appointment clause

topics.headline: actual but unspecified appointment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the appointment is certain in existence but unspecified in detail, which makes deferral ominous rather than vague.
topics.reason: QAC marks a nominative indefinite time/place noun as delayed subject; the status is narrowed because the bundle flags the assigned root as needing correction toward the promise/appointment field.

topics.headline: promise-threat time-place field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word holds promise/threat and time/place together, so the delay is a designated rendezvous point, not simple postponement.
topics.reason: Lexical rows correct the local force toward the standard promise/threat root and mafʿil time-place morphology; this narrows away from the assigned root without rejecting the word.

topics.headline: appointment echoed forward and twinned with refuge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 18:59 immediately concretizes the appointment language, while the later refuge noun in 18:58 sounds like its denied counterpart.
topics.reason: The forward echo to 18:59 and the sound/shape pairing with the final refuge noun are explicit CRITICAL rows and remain local payoffs.

words.gloss_range: emphatic future negator governing the final finding verb
words.prose: {{ar:لَنْ}} ({{tr:lan}}) begins the final impossibility clause. It governs the following verb in subjunctive form and echoes 18:57, where the preceding ayah closed with no guidance; here the closure becomes no refuge.

topics.headline: terminal future impossibility
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the appointment is followed by an emphatic future denial of escape, echoing the no-guidance closure of 18:57.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as a subjunctive negator, and the following verb-form plus boundary rows support terminal impossibility.

words.gloss_range: negated Form I finding verb with plural subject and direct refuge object
words.prose: {{ar:يَجِدُوا۟}} ({{tr:yajidu}}) is the verb governed by {{ar:لَنْ}} ({{tr:lan}}). The assigned root is narrowed toward the standard finding root, because the local syntax denies finding or encountering a refuge; in Surah 18 this also recalls 18:27, where a similar no-alternative formula used a different refuge word.
words.root_gloss_range: assigned data gives {{ar:ج د د}} ({{tr:j-d-d}}), but local lexical evidence narrows/corrects the verb toward {{ar:و ج د}} ({{tr:w-j-d}}): finding, encountering, discovering, and existential availability

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: emphatic future negator governing the finding verb

topics.headline: negated search for refuge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final clause denies even basic finding of any refuge, not merely successful use of one.
topics.reason: QAC marks Form I imperfect governed by lan and attachment evidence gives the final refuge noun as object; status is narrowed because the bundle flags standard w-j-d finding against the assigned root.

topics.headline: Surah 18 no-alternative formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 18:58 returns to the no-alternative formula of 18:27 but changes the escape noun, mapping failed guidance into failed refuge.
topics.reason: The explicit 18:27 formula rows and boundary rows are coherent inter-ayah evidence; they do not govern the local parse but preserve the motif.

words.gloss_range: separative preposition forming the compound apart-from exclusion phrase
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) starts the compound apart-from phrase. By placing the exclusion phrase between the finding verb and the refuge object, the ayah closes the outside domain before naming what they will fail to find.

topics.headline: apart-from domain closed before refuge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the search-space is closed before the refuge noun arrives.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence governs the following noun through this preposition, and the rows coherently preserve the compound exclusion unit.

words.gloss_range: genitive apart-from noun with ambiguous suffix, excluding any lower or outside alternative
words.prose: {{ar:دُونِهِ}} ({{tr:dunihi}}) is governed by {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) and carries a suffix the bundle warns not to over-resolve. If it points to the Lord, no refuge exists apart from Him; if it points to the appointment, no refuge exists apart from that appointed moment. Its apart/below range also makes any outside alternative inferior and unavailable, tying 18:58 to the no-alternative language of 18:26 and 18:27.
words.root_gloss_range: below, beneath, apart from, other than; local phrase selects compound exclusion, with suffix ambiguity between the Lord and the appointment left live

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: separative preposition governing the apart-from phrase

topics.headline: ambiguous referent doubles closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the suffix can point to the Lord or to the appointment, making the denial both relational and temporal.
topics.reason: Translation support warns not to resolve the suffix in default, and the CRITICAL rows preserve the valid ambiguity.

topics.headline: apart-from and below-ness exclusion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase denies not just another option but any lower, outside, or inferior domain of refuge.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the noun genitive under min; the below/apart lexical rows are compatible with the local exclusion formula.

topics.headline: Surah 18 exclusion spine
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 18:58 belongs to Surah 18’s repeated no-alternative language, including 18:26 and 18:27, while using the final refuge noun of this ayah.
topics.reason: The same-surah formula rows give concrete anchors and remain evidence for motif, not for changing the local grammar.

words.gloss_range: indefinite hapax refuge-place noun as the final denied object of finding
words.prose: {{ar:مَوْئِلًا}} ({{tr:mawilan}}) is the final accusative object of the negated finding verb, an indefinite refuge-place that they will not find. The standard hamzated form selects shelter or retreat, while variant pressure toward protection and turning broadens the denied fallback without replacing the standard sense. As a hapax final word, it echoes {{ar:مَوْعِدٌ}} ({{tr:mawidun}}) in sound and, set against the opening covering-forgiveness, closes the ayah by denying every escape route after mercy has deferred the punishment.
words.root_gloss_range: retreating to shelter or refuge, with accepted variant pressure toward turning/protection; local standard selects refuge-place while variants broaden the denied fallback field

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: appointed time-place noun affirmed before the denied refuge noun

topics.headline: final object of failed search
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah lands on an indefinite refuge object: not one shelter, but any possible place of retreat is denied.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the noun accusative direct object of the finding verb; closure position and indefiniteness preserve the CRITICAL payoff.

topics.headline: standard refuge with variant protection pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the standard hamzated refuge word denies shelter, while variant pressure toward protection/turning expands the felt loss without replacing the standard reading.
topics.reason: Accepted variant rows are valid apparatus evidence, but QAC and the standard surface keep w-ʾ-l refuge as the local selected sense.

topics.headline: hapax echo seals no escape
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rare final word is acoustically paired with the appointment and thematically framed by opening covering, making no escape the ayah’s closing seal.
topics.reason: The hapax, 18:27 echo, appointment-refuge sound echo, and opening/closing frame rows converge on a local closure payoff.
